name: H-E-B eCommerce Fulfillment Center - Katy - Katy TX

fieldNotes.truckGate: Truck entrance is a wide open curb-cut off Elrod Rd at the NW of the property; green ornamental security fence runs along the road frontage but terminates open at the driveway - no barrier arm, sliding gate, or pinch-point checkpoint. Confirmed in 2023-07 Street View.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth at the truck entrance; only a tall H-E-B monument sign at the corner.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because there is no truck gate at all.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved dock apron inside the property line provides ample internal queue space before the dock doors.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Dock apron is deep enough to stack 3+ trucks between the road and the dock face.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: ~12-15 dock doors with awnings along the entire west building face, confirmed in Street View; banded 10-25.
fieldNotes.dropArea: A few trailers parked on the apron without tractors; not a formal striped drop lot. Low confidence.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide driveway apron and unused paved width could support an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Within the dense Katy suburban fabric of metro Houston, surrounded by residential subdivisions.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: Approx 7 trailers/trucks counted in captured imagery at docks and on apron; imagery dates vary.
